title: Customer Evidence Board
purpose: Decide what the evidence allows you to say, and what to investigate next.
disclosure: FICTIONAL WORKED EXAMPLE. All products, feedback and constraints here are synthetic. No campaign has run and no performance result is claimed.

sources.label: Fictional product brief
sources.text: A fictional packing cube has a labeled divider and two zipped compartments. No tested time saving, capacity gain or durability claim is supplied.

sources.label: Positive feedback
sources.text: I could see which side held the clean shirts.

sources.label: Mixed feedback
sources.text: The divider helped, but the cube felt bulky in my small bag.

sources.label: Unresolved buyer question
sources.text: Will it fit my 18 litre backpack?

sources.label: Production inventory
sources.text: One prototype, one phone, one tabletop and one editor are available. No customer testimonial footage is licensed.

cards.title: A narrow, demonstrable message

fields.Observation: I could see which side held the clean shirts.
fields.Counterevidence: The divider helped, but the cube felt bulky in my small bag.
fields.Sample scope: Two fictional feedback statements and one question. No prevalence estimate.
fields.Permitted wording: Show two zipped compartments; do not promise faster completion.

cards.next: Capture a direct demonstration of the specified feature.

cards.title: Fit in a small backpack
cards.decision: The question is useful for research; it is not an established product capability.

fields.Observation: Will it fit my 18 litre backpack?
fields.Counterevidence: No answer or completed compatibility check supplied.
fields.Sample scope: One fictional question; no frequency inference.
fields.Permitted wording: Ask what the buyer needs to verify before purchase.

cards.next: Run the missing compatibility check and retain the result, including failure.

cards.title: Reject the speed promise
cards.decision: Pack twice as much in half the time.

fields.Observation: No measured comparison supports this draft claim.
fields.Counterevidence: The divider helped, but the cube felt bulky in my small bag.
fields.Sample scope: The supplied material has no controlled time study.

cards.next: Remove the numerical promise from the brief; revisit only with valid measurements.
